summary: The fixed-rank depth bound follows correctly by applying the accepted uniform rank-cap theorem to the saturated intrinsic stopped-body chart, transferring intrinsic depth to the ambient mixed-integer set without a lattice or fiber-volume loss, and combining the stopped-mass and ledger inequalities with correct constants and strictness. For the sequence, the nonnegative depth summand gives the stated normalized depth decay, the fixed-rank bound forces the exact eventual quantifiers for q_j, and the selector estimate together with gamma_d>4/11 yields the pointwise lower bound on r_j+1 and hence its exact divergence quantifiers. All hypotheses required by the cited predecessor facts are supplied, including positivity, full intrinsic dimension, exact positive-support rank, and the vacuous R_0=0 case.
